RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel signals poor diversity practices and increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but it does not prove discrimination. In banking, a head of risk modelling role frequently prioritizes broad regulatory affairs experience and supervisory relationships over pure statistical expertise, providing a legitimate business rationale for the hiring decision.

Raising the panel's gender composition now without concrete evidence will likely be perceived as an unsubstantiated accusation, damaging your professional reputation and relationships in a specialized market. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your regulatory background. Only consider raising discrimination if tangible evidence emerges or after consulting an employment lawyer.
